mapper.sql: k.id,k.key_code,k.name,k.secret_hash,k.key_prefix,k.knowledge_base_id,k.principal_id AS principalId, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_principal_kb_grant g WHERE g.principal_id=k.principal_id AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS grantedKnowledgeBaseCount, b.name AS knowledge_base_name,k.scopes,k.rate_limit_per_minute,k.status,k.expires_at,k.last_used_at, p.name AS principalName, k.created_by,u.display_name AS created_by_name,k.created_time,k.updated_time,k.allowed_origins, k.memory_namespace AS memoryNamespace,k.memory_agent_code AS memoryAgentCode, k.memory_read_enabled AS memoryReadEnabled,k.memory_write_enabled AS memoryWriteEnabled, CAST(k.permission_tags AS CHAR) AS permissionTags
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by ORDER BY k.created_time DESC
SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by WHERE k.id=#{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM t_api_key k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base b ON b.id=k.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN t_principal p ON p.id=k.principal_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=k.created_by WHERE k.secret_hash=#{secretHash} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_principal WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id,p.principal_code AS principalCode,p.name,p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT k.id) AS keyCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.status='ACTIVE' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) THEN g.id END) AS activeGrantCount, p.created_time AS createdTime FROM t_principal p LEFT JOIN t_api_key k ON k.principal_id=p.id LEFT JOIN t_principal_kb_grant g ON g.principal_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id,p.principal_code,p.name,p.status,p.created_time ORDER BY p.created_time DESC,p.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_principal_kb_grant(principal_id,knowledge_base_id,status,reason,created_by,expires_at) SELECT #{targetPrincipalId},knowledge_base_id,'ACTIVE',reason,#{createdBy},expires_at FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{sourcePrincipalId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_knowledge_base WHERE id=#{knowledgeBaseId}
SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY knowledge_base_id
SELECT knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId,expires_at AS expiresAt, reason,status,created_time AS createdTime FROM t_principal_kb_grant WHERE principal_id=#{principalId} ORDER BY knowledge_base_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_api_key SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_api_key SET last_used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE channel=#{channel} ORDER BY created_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE trace_id=#{traceId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_api_call_audit ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errorCount, AVG(duration_ms) avgDurationMs,MAX(duration_ms) maxDurationMs FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE created_time >= #{since}
SELECT duration_ms FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE created_time >= #{since} ORDER BY duration_ms ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT channel,SUM(CASE WHEN status_code < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errorCount FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE created_time >= #{since} GROUP BY channel
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_api_key WHERE status='ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM t_embed_token_revocation WHERE jti=#{jti} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_embed_token_revocation ORDER BY revoked_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT token_jti jti,MAX(key_id) keyId,MAX(key_code) keyCode, MAX(knowledge_base_id) knowledgeBaseId,MAX(origin) origin,COUNT(*) calls, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errors,MAX(created_time) lastCallTime, MIN(created_time) firstCallTime FROM t_api_call_audit WHERE token_jti IS NOT NULL AND token_jti <> '' AND created_time >= #{since} GROUP BY token_jti ORDER BY lastCallTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
